title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-003
doc_notes: This document consists of correspondence and administrative records from the FAA regarding public requests for information about the JAL Flight 1628 UFO sighting.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 crew reported sighting an unidentified object while flying over Alaska.
behavior: shadowed by two belts of light
incidents.explanation: Investigator Philip J. Klass concluded the pilot was seeing an unusually bright image of the planet Jupiter and possibly Mars.
incidents.quote: JAL Captain Kenjyu Terauchi reported on November 17 that his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light
